newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish OTC company takes on new shareholders.
newsitem.headline: Polish OTC company takes on new shareholders.

text.p: Seven investors took a new ex-rights issue of 479,255 shares in Polish firm Centralna Tabela Ofert SA (CeTO) which runs the regulated over-the-counter securities market, CeTO said in a statement on Friday.
It said its extraordinary shareholders' meeting raised the number of shares to about 1.7 million and the new shares were sold at 3.5 zlotys each.

It said its shareholders also agreed to allow insurance firms, other financial institutions and issuers, whose shares are cleared for public trade and are listed on the OTC market, to become the firm's shareholders.
So far only securities firms have been CeTO's shareholders and until now it had 45 members.
CeTO said its shareholders also agreed on another issue of up to 5.2-million-rights at 3.5 zlotys per share, but did not give any details.
